page: Amazon Web Services c8id.12xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor with 48 vCPUs, 24 physical cores, and a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The system includes 96.0 GB of DDR5 RAM operating at 7 GHz, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. Local storage is provided via 2850 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes, and baseline network bandwidth is rated at 22 Gbps.

The x86_64 CPU architecture supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and int8 operations. In performance testing, the instance demonstrates strong capabilities, achieving a Geekbench single-core score of 2200.0 and a multi-core score of 19875.0. It excels in image processing and text processing, placing in the top tier of benchmarks. Cryptographic performance is also strong, with a Passmark CPU encryption score of 54309.76, aided by hardware-accelerated AES and SHA instructions.

Memory performance is characterized by a strong read-only small block cached bandwidth of 3859.38 GB/sec and a large block uncached bandwidth of 194.95 GB/sec. The combination of high-speed DDR5 memory and local NVMe SSD storage supports demanding database operations, as reflected in a Passmark database score of 24113.72 and Redis SET operations reaching 86.36 million operations per second. This hardware profile is highly suitable for compute-intensive workloads, software compilation, database hosting, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
